body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 04d8f749178768d8553c96125c092f9343b2e41a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Reviewed commit 04d8f749 only (#664); the rest of the stack is #573, reviewed earlier.

**What looks good**
- Frame ordering is sound: `pages::properties` clears the shown-rows markers, draws the page (the rows record their setup as they draw, so a pick armed by a click on its row this frame is already in `setup_pick_rows`), and only then runs `disarm_hidden`. There is no one-frame lag, and arming is not undone on the frame it happens. The tests use real clicks and confirm it.
- The plane draft is paused, not dropped: `PlanePick.picking` / `pause()` / `collecting()`. Re-arming the same setup keeps the picked face. The row shows the face and Apply while disarmed, and "Stop picking" still drops the draft.
- Click routing (`interact.rs`, `vertex_pick.rs`, `hint_stray`) and the outline drawing all go through `collecting`, so a paused draft cannot swallow operation-page picks.
- Disarming is plain view state: it writes no command and pushes no undo entry. No `unwrap`/`expect` added, the decision record is present, and no snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG, build.rs, `.github` or dependency change is in the PR.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main; already up to date, no conflicts)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 389 pass, 1 fail: `headless_run_succeeds`, "No suitable graphics adapter found" (environmental) |
| `setup_picks_disarm` (3) + `plane_face_pick` | pass |
| `camcraft-app --test axis_align` | 10 pass |
| `camcraft-app --test plane_align` | 8 pass |
| clippy `-p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |
| Spot-check: `disarm_hidden` call commented out | all 3 `setup_picks_disarm` tests FAIL; restored afterwards |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The sweep runs only when `Tab::Properties` is drawn (`shell.rs:945`). If the Properties tab is ever docked as a tab behind another (for example Browser) and the user switches to the other tab with a pick armed, the sweep does not run and the pick stays armed against rows not on screen. Operation-page clicks cannot be misrouted that way, since no operation page is showing, but it is worth a follow-up if the layout lets the tabs share a leaf.
- PR is stacked on #573; it merges after its parent.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
